source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-37

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic shift linkage adjustment (Corvette)
steps: Put the console selector lever in Drive.
Put the control lever on the transmission in its Drive position.
Connect the cable and secure it with the retaining clip and cotter pin as shown in view A of figure 4T in the manual.

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic detent switch adjustment
steps: Adjust the switch as shown in figure 1T in the manual (Corvette procedure on page 7-34).

procedures.title: Neutral safety switch adjustment (Turbo Hydra-Matic)
steps: Set the switch so the engine cranks in Park and Neutral only, not in any other position.

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic: drain and refill
steps: Drain right after driving, while the fluid is still hot.
Remove the pan screws, pan and gasket; throw the gasket away.
Remove the strainer retainer bolt, the strainer and the intake pipe O-ring; discard the strainer and O-ring.
Fit a new O-ring on the intake pipe and a new strainer on the pipe.
Clean the pan thoroughly.
Stick a new gasket to the pan with petroleum jelly.
Install the pan and torque its screws to specification.
Pour in fluid using a clean container, spout or funnel: about 7-1/2 pints if only the pan was off, 9-1/2 pints if the valve body was also removed, about 19 pints after a full overhaul.
Start the engine and let it idle with the carburetor off the fast idle step; set the selector to P and apply the hand brake.
Top up: warm (about 180°F) to the FULL mark; at room temperature (about 70°F) to 1/4" below ADD.

specs.what: refill, pan and valve body removed

notes: Caution: do not overfill; it will foam.

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic pressure regulator valve: remove and install
steps: Remove the bottom pan and strainer.
Push the boost valve bushing in against the regulator spring and take out the snap ring with J-5403 pliers.
Remove the boost valve bushing and valve.
Remove the regulator spring.
Remove the regulator valve, spring retainer and any spacers.
Install in reverse order and set the fluid level.

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic control valve body: remove and install
steps: Remove the bottom pan and strainer.
Unplug the solenoid lead from the connector terminal.
Remove the valve body screws and the detent roller spring assembly; leave the solenoid screws in place.
Lower out the valve body with the governor pipes; handled carefully, the six check balls stay in place above the spacer plate.
Take the governor pipes and manual valve off the valve body.
Install in reverse order and set the fluid level.
notes: Caution: do not let the manual valve fall out.

procedures.title: Turbo Hydra-Matic governor: remove and install
steps: Remove the governor cover screws, cover and gasket.
Throw away the gasket.
